findings.expected: A page for a database, table or field that does not exist should say so in words (a "not found" message, a 404 page) and offer a way back to the data reference.
findings.actual: The data reference renders a normal-looking but empty detail page with no name anywhere: empty title, breadcrumb without the last step, 'No description yet' used as the actual name and data type, and generated questions with the entity name missing ('Count of', 'See raw data for', 'Number of Orders grouped by'). The page still offers Edit and X-ray actions on nothing. For /reference/databases/999 the API answers 404 and the page shows no error at all.

Clicking it sends POST /api/card, which returns 400, and the dialog shows the raw API message \"Value must be a non-blank string.\" under the Name field while the Save button changes its label to \"Failed\" and stays disabled. The name has to be retyped before saving is possible again.

After reload the description is back to the previously saved value 'agent12 updated description'. Clicking outside the field instead does send PUT /api/card/45 and the value is kept, so only the Enter key loses the edit. (on /model/45-agent12-model-beta (Info panel → Overview → Description))
findings.expected: Enter in the single-line description field commits the new description, as it does elsewhere in the app; after reload the Info panel shows 'agent12 third description'.
findings.actual: Enter sends no request: the field stays in edit mode with the typed text and the edit is silently discarded. After reload the description is back to the previously saved value 'agent12 updated description'. Clicking outside the field instead does send PUT /api/card/45 and the value is kept, so only the Enter key loses the edit.
reproSteps: Open /model/45-agent12-model-beta (model 'agent12-model-beta', formerly agent12-model-alpha, in Our analytics).
Click the circle-i 'More info' button in the header to open the Info panel.
Click the description text under the 'Description' heading so it turns into a text input.

findings.name: Model save dialog disables \"Save\" with no message when the model name is long (prefilled \"<name> - Modified\" exceeds 254 characters)
findings.summary: The dialog prefills the Name with the model's 254-character name plus \" - Modified\" (265 characters, longer than the field's own 254-character limit), and the dialog's \"Save\" button stays greyed out and cannot be clicked, with no error or explanation anywhere in the dialog. Typing a short name (agent2-short) immediately enables Save, so the length is the cause. (on /model/44/notebook)
findings.expected: Either the suggested name fits the limit (or is trimmed) and Save works, or the dialog says why it cannot be saved (e.g. \"Name must be 254 characters or fewer\").
findings.actual: The dialog prefills the Name with the model's 254-character name plus \" - Modified\" (265 characters, longer than the field's own 254-character limit), and the dialog's \"Save\" button stays greyed out and cannot be clicked, with no error or explanation anywhere in the dialog. Typing a short name (agent2-short) immediately enables Save, so the length is the cause.
reproSteps: Create a model (Browse → Models → the + ) and give it the longest name the title field accepts: type a name of 300+ characters such as "agent2-" followed by repeated "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"; the title field caps it at 254 characters and saves it.
Open that model and click Editor to reach /model/<id>/notebook.
Click "Row limit", type 10 in "Enter a limit" and press Tab so the "Save" button appears.
Click Save. The dialog "Save new question" opens with Name = the 254-character model name + " - Modified" (265 characters).
Look at the dialog's "Save" button: it is disabled and clicking it does nothing; no validation message is shown. Replace the Name with a short text and the button becomes enabled.

findings.name: Global search treats % and _ as wildcards: searching for them returns 70+ unrelated items
findings.summary: Searching for the single wildcard characters \"%\" or \"_\" returns almost the whole library: 72 results for \"%\" and 70 for \"_\" (e.g. \"Orders + People\", \"Release requests by region and category\", \"agent7-metric-count\"), even though none of those names contains \"%\" or \"_\". The characters are treated as SQL-LIKE wildcards instead of literal text. (on /search?q=%25 and /search?q=_ (global search))
findings.expected: Only items whose name or description contains the typed character are returned (a name with \"%\" or \"_\", e.g. \"agent7-metric-count\" for \"_\"), or, if nothing matches, the \"Didn't find anything\" empty state — not the entire library.
findings.actual: Searching for the single wildcard characters \"%\" or \"_\" returns almost the whole library: 72 results for \"%\" and 70 for \"_\" (e.g. \"Orders + People\", \"Release requests by region and category\", \"agent7-metric-count\"), even though none of those names contains \"%\" or \"_\". The characters are treated as SQL-LIKE wildcards instead of literal text.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1.
Open the global search from the top bar (the "Search..." box, or Ctrl/Cmd+K) and type a single underscore _ , then press Enter, or open https://5501-irj19dkxmuqxplj4vepre.e2b.app/search?q=_ directly.
Read the result count and the names listed (70 RESULTS, including items with no underscore such as "Orders + People").
Repeat with a single percent sign % (https://5501-irj19dkxmuqxplj4vepre.e2b.app/search?q=%25): 72 RESULTS, again listing items without a % in the name.

findings.expected: Each History entry describes only what actually changed: for the rename 'renamed this Card from "agent12-model-alpha" to "agent12-model-beta"' and for the edit 'changed the description', with no mention of a pin position change that did not happen.
findings.actual: Both revision summaries claim an unpublished pin change that never happened: the rename revision reads 'renamed this Card from "agent12-model-alpha" to "agent12-model-beta", edited the metadata and changed pin position.' and the description edit reads 'changed pin position and changed the description.' The model was never pinned or unpinned — it was only renamed (title field) and had its description edited once in the Info panel, and it still appears unpinned among the ordinary models of Our analytics.
reproSteps: Open /model/45-agent12-model-beta (the model agent12-model-beta, in Our analytics; it was created in this hunt and is now in the trash).
Click the circle-i 'More info' button in the header.

Read the two revision entries: the rename one and the 'changed pin position and changed the description' one.
